focus: Donald D. Hoffman's research on visual space as a perceptual interface, fitness-versus-truth selection, conscious-agent Markov kernels, emergent spacetime; guard against conflating hypotheses with established physics.

literature.title: The generic-viewpoint assumption and illusory contours
literature.limit: Not seagull vision or digitized gull brain.

literature.title: Objects of consciousness
literature.role: Conscious-agent mathematical formalism with Markov kernels
literature.limit: Subjective consciousness as ontological primitive remains a hypothesis.

literature.title: The Interface Theory of Perception
literature.limit: Species-specific perception design does not directly prove physical spacetime fictional.

literature.title: Fact, Fiction, and Fitness
literature.role: Mathematical claims about structural non-veridicality under model assumptions
literature.limit: Game/payoff assumptions and generalizability are contested.

literature.title: Fitness Beats Truth in the Evolution of Perception
literature.authors: Prakash, Stephens, Hoffman, Singh and Fields
literature.role: Fitness-only versus truth-estimation theorem within specified perceptual decision framework
literature.limit: Logical theorem does not infer all animal perception entirely false independently of premises.

literature.title: Fusions of Consciousness
literature.limit: No established real-world proof consciousness is the physical substrate of spacetime.

literature.title: Interfacing consciousness
literature.limit: Hypothetical ontological research program, not established physical neuroscience.

literature.title: Spacetime Is Doomed: Time Is an Artifact
literature.role: Proposal of an emergent entropic time arrow under projection of deeper Markov dynamics
literature.limit: Projection argument is not a proof of operational retrocausal communication.

literature.title: Traces of Consciousness
literature.role: Trace order and logic of observers in Markov systems
literature.limit: Mathematical speculation and proposed physical connection not independently experimentally validated.

literature.title: The Case Against The Case Against Reality
literature.role: Independent critique on FBT theorem interpretation and evolutionary simulation assumptions
literature.limit: Criticism is part of open scientific debate, not proof that all particular Hoffman mathematical results are false.

scientific_boundary.physically_observed_space_illusions: Human psychophysics establishes context-dependent perceptual reconstruction; does not falsify external spacetime.
scientific_boundary.gull_transfer_use: Hypothesis for observer-perception-action architecture only. Require separate Laridae anatomy, retina, field-of-view and spatial behavior datasets before calling biological model species-specific.
scientific_boundary.mathematical_agent_kernels: Use P:W→X, D:X→G, A:G→W as stochastic kernels, but do not label a CPU automaton conscious as a scientific fact.
scientific_boundary.origin_of_space_and_time: Hoffman's primacy-of-consciousness claim is a research hypothesis, not established observation.
scientific_boundary.retrocausality: No physical or mathematical theorem here establishes backward communication of independently free future bits in real spacetime.

source_artifacts.source_lang: Russian authored summaries with original DOI/source URLs; not copyrighted article verbatim

training_evidence.first_failure_category: Corpus minimum answer length too strict and wrong missing-card test ordering; changed validation only, scientific content unchanged.
training_evidence.native_model_scope: Tiny byte-level language-model adaptation does not equate to trained 3D visual brain or scientific understanding of spacetime.

next_scientific_task: Evaluate observer-specific visual/spatial predictions from the current corpus with independently measured bird visual data; contrast verified geometry and rival interface hypotheses. Do not retrain/promote against original protected anchor until positive evidence on held-out evaluation.
